verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪ : ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕਿਕੂੰ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ?
verses.translit_en: pauRee 14 : prem ras kikoo(n) miladhaa hai ?

en.bdb: How is the joy of love attained?

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਮੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras hui gurusikh melaa|

en.bdb: After meeting the Guru i.e. after adopting the teachings of the Guru, the gurmukh receives the pleasure-fruit of the joy of love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਚਾਇ ਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat parachai kai nit neh navelaa|

en.bdb: The Guru merges the consciousness of the disciple into the Word and creates ever-new love for the Lord in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜਾਉ ਚੜਿ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: veeh ikeeh chaRaau chaR sikh gur gur chelaa|

en.bdb: Thus getting above the worldliness, the disciple becomes Guru and the Guru disciple.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਐ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: apiau peeaai ajar jarai gur sev suhelaa|

en.bdb: Now he quaffs the unbearable drink of the juice of love and further bears the unbearable. But all this becomes possible only through the service of the Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਹਾਰਿ ਜਿਣੈ ਵਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: jeevadhiaa mar chalanaa haar jinai vahelaa|

en.bdb: (To attain the delight of love) One has to put to death his ego and by becoming indifferent to the world has to conquer it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਲ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੇਲਾ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: sil aloonee chaTanee lakh a(n)mirat pelaa ||14||

en.bdb: One who has licked this tasteless (unsalty) stone i.e. who has adopted the way of desireless devotion, he alone throws away myriads of delights equal to the immortalising elixirs.
